purpose: Test whether source-derived reader-experience knowledge helps when used only as a passive validator on an already fixed natural baseline, with one located defect and one minimal repair. Do not expose a candidate stack as prose-generation targets.
required_method: Read the fixed B baseline exactly as already judged by the human.
Run RX-C01 through RX-C08 only as passive validators; do not tell a prose generator to satisfy them.
If no material located defect exists, return NO_REPAIR_JUSTIFIED and stop.
If defects exist, rank by likely reader impact and select exactly one located defect.
Produce one minimally repaired version that changes only the selected defect and preserves unrelated wording/structure.
Blind the labels before actual-human comparison.
Do not stack multiple RX repairs.
Do not add countdowns, extra clues, extra mysteries, or deliberate motive withholding merely to satisfy a rule.
next_after_human_win: One bounded span-growth survival test for the single repaired dimension only.
next_after_human_loss_or_tie: Reject that validator repair; return to diagnosis without scale-up.
